dialogues.speaker: Honglang
dialogues.text: This Domain... What secrets lie inside it...

choices.text: What can you tell me about this Domain's initial appearance?

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: Um, honestly, we can't be sure ourselves.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Didn't you say that this place was this big, gloomy, empty room?

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: Well, that was... also something that the team of adventurers "desired," you see.

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: When entering this Domain, each of them only had one thought in mind...

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: "How I wish this place was a space heretofore unexplored by anyone."

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: And so this Domain responded to their desires, turning into something most strange.

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: So as to what this Domain might have originally been like... I suspect that it might have been "nothing at all."

choices.text: Is it safe to adventure in here?

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: As long as you do as I instructed, I'm confident that nothing will go wrong.

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: Still, I suggest that you not come into this with any particularly large wishes, just to avoid... you know, any unforeseen results.

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: Yes, see you. Do be careful while operating this Domain, now.
